summaries.zh: Kimi WebBridge for DeepSeek Harness — a third-party dsh plugin bundle that turns the local Kimi WebBridge daemon into 15 native kimi_webbridge_* browser tools (navigate, click, fill, snapshot, screenshot, evaluate, network, upload, PDF).
